marketing.v: Apple Mac mini (M6), board j873g; H18/T8152. Source DTS model string says Mac mini (M6). The generation name H18 comes from firmware h18; T8152 is not claimed to be M5.

other_h18_ids.reason: Searched the complete macOS 27.0 (26A428) IPSW ADT and BuildManifest extracts recorded in AneAllSoc receipts. The 27.0 ADT list has T8152 as the only H18 SoC id; no T8160/T8162 or other newer SoC id appears. Also checked the macOS 13.5 (22G74) extracted ADT/BuildManifest set; no T8152/H18 row there. This only establishes absence in these searched restore images, not future catalog availability.

ane_segment_ranges.reason: No segment-ranges property in the IPSW j873g ADT. A live macOS IORegistry/m1n1 ADT observation is required to discover iBoot's runtime firmware placement; not measured offline.

ane_domains.v: ADT names DCS2 and DCS3 clock gates; it does not show the T6021-style ANE_SYS/CPU/SET state sequence.

dart_sid.reason: No sid property in the IPSW ADT; a live IORegistry or trace is needed.

mailbox.reason: No separate mailbox node appears in the T8152 IPSW ADT. The host/ASC mailbox protocol and addresses are not identified by static ADT data; do not infer that the interface is integrated.

firmware.v: BuildManifest maps j873gap to h18_ane0_fw_kirkland_j8xx.im4p and h18_ane1_fw_kirkland_j8xx.im4p. AneAllSoc fetch receipt reports each IPSW member as 1,572,889 bytes. Encrypted payload: not decrypted or copied. The exact per-member firmware SHA-256 is not present in the fetched hash list.

kext.reason: AneAllSoc's 27.0 fetch receipt contains BuildManifest and ADT members but no j873g kernelcache member; no T8152 kernelcache kext class was measured.

driver_family.v: New family indicated by iop-ane,ascwrap-v8 and dart,gen3. No existing omarchy-ane driver matches this compatible. No H18 driver or mailbox protocol has been implemented or tested.

compiler.v: H18 target absent from the measured cross-target compile. Existing receipt gives CPU subtypes h13=4, h14=5, h15=6, h16=7, h17=9. Any H18 subtype/ISA mapping is unknown; no extrapolated subtype is claimed.

aurora.v: aurora-wip contains t8152-j873g.dts, titled Apple Mac mini (M6), but no ANE node or H18 ANE driver. The file is a minimal RAM-boot DT. No ANE overlay target exists in linux-asahi 7.1.13.
